name: flow_duel_party_two_sides
description: An Undertow party on a server (M7, design 1.4, 5.2), with the race's team handling: alone the leader's button is Find a rival, there are no open seats, the mode line says 1v1, and the queue's offer of caretakers is said in the duel's words (a race's and High Water's in theirs). A member joins the other side, and the well shows the rows by team (A, B): Start once she is Ready. Neither row moves, since a duel is one a side (no 'Click to move' and a click sends nothing); two on one side may part, the row moving to the empty side. A third member makes the party more than a duel holds: Start waits with 'A duel is one against one' until the party is two again.

steps.assert: Session.offer_text() == 'Caretakers can fill the open seats'
steps.msg: High Water's caretakers fill open seats
a race's caretakers race the team

steps.assert: Session.offer_text() == 'The caretaker can be your rival'
steps.msg: a duel's caretaker is the rival

steps.assert: node('HubPanel').primary_text() == 'Find a rival' and not node('Primary').disabled and not node('OpenSeats').visible
steps.msg: a duel party of one online: Find a rival, no open seats

steps.assert: node('HubPanel').lines() == ['A diamond Sascha lamplighter leader', 'B circle Ana lookout', '+ invite', '+ invite']
node('HubPanel').primary_text() == 'Start' and node('Primary').disabled and node('PrimaryLine').text == 'Waiting for Ana'
steps.msg: both sides filled: Start, once Ana is Ready

steps.assert: node('Member1').tooltip_text == '' and node('Member2').tooltip_text == '' and not Session.can_move(0) and not Session.can_move(1)
steps.msg: one a side: neither row moves

steps.assert: not Session.one_team() and Session.even_teams() and node('HubPanel').lines()[1] == 'B circle Ana lookout'
steps.msg: the click sent nothing: Ana keeps her side

steps.assert: node('HubPanel').primary_text() == 'Start' and node('Primary').disabled and node('PrimaryLine').text == 'Two teams of one size: click a row to move it'
steps.msg: two on one side are no duel

steps.assert: node('Member2').tooltip_text == 'Click to move to the other team' and Session.can_move(1)
steps.msg: ... and either may move to the empty side

steps.assert: node('HubPanel').lines()[1] == 'B circle Ana lookout' and node('Member2').tooltip_text == ''
steps.msg: PARTY team: Ana on side B again, and no row moves now

steps.assert: node('HubPanel').primary_text() == 'Start' and node('Primary').disabled and node('PrimaryLine').text == 'A duel is one against one'
steps.msg: three are more than a duel holds

steps.assert: not Session.can_move(0) and not Session.can_move(1) and not Session.can_move(2)
steps.msg: and no move makes them fit

steps.assert: node('HubPanel').primary_text() == 'Start' and node('PrimaryLine').text != 'A duel is one against one'
